commands: for f in "lib/test/run.sh" "lib/test/run-parallel.sh" "lib/test/run-shard.sh" "lib/test/modules/parallel-suite-runner.sh" "lib/test/modules/coverage-map.json"; do echo "===== $f ====="; sed -n "/^diff --git a\/$（echo $f | sed 's/\//\\\//g'）/,/^diff --git /p" .prflow/tmp/review/pr-2005/33007781837-1/diff.patch; done 2>/dev/null | head -5; echo "fallback below"

mkdir -p .prflow/tmp
rm -f ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before" ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-disabled" 2>/dev/null &&
git status --porcelain -z > ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before" &&
[ -f ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before" ] &&
[ ! -L ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before" ] &&
git hash-object ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before"

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
